term: positive (the constant P of Gödel's 1970 variant, AFP GoedelVariantHOML1.thy)
definition: `Positivity`: an undeclared constant P (PositiveProperty :: (e⇒σ)⇒σ) that says, at each world, which properties are positive there. It has the type of Scott's P (the same Lean type `TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.GoedelGod.Positivity`), but the theory constrains it only by its own axioms Ax1, Ax2a, Ax2b, Ax3 and Ax4, not by Scott's A1a-A5, so a result about one constant says nothing about the other. Not Aquinas's perfection; no statement identifies the two.
